directed_evidence.finding: Current mapping enforces tenant FK, positive tenant, non-empty recipient/idempotency, valid states/attempts, content-or-template exclusivity, tenant-scoped uniqueness, claim indexes, correlation and provider message tracking.

Existing migration is additive and reversible, creates only email queue/template persistence, constraints and indexes, stores no SMTP/provider credential, performs no backfill, and has explicit Down drops.
All repository reads are tenant-filtered; pagination is bounded; idempotency and message lookups are tenant scoped.

assessment.reason: No new persistence delta is being introduced; current-standard review verifies the already-versioned additive migration and mapping. Running destructive rollback or inventing a new migration would be non-causal.

rollback: No DB change was executed in this revalidation. The versioned historical migration has an explicit Down path, but active Development data was not rolled back because there is no current schema delta to validate.
